description: This source file defines a Swift module for managing WebSocket gateway connections within an application. It includes enumerations for channels, payload structures, a singleton actor for handling the connection lifecycle, request/response handling, and various API methods for communication with the gateway, including chat, system events, skills, sessions, cron jobs, and health checks.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: A singleton actor that manages a WebSocket connection to a gateway server, providing methods for request/response handling and pushing data to subscribers. It also handles configuration, reconnection logic, and high-level API calls related to the gateway functionality.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a generic request to the gateway with specified method and parameters, returning raw data.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Performs a raw request to the gateway with specified method and parameters, returning raw data.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Performs a request to the gateway and decodes the response into the specified Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Performs a request expecting no return value, for commands that do not produce a response.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconfigures the WebSocket connection based on current configuration.

methods.name: authSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication source for the current connection.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the current gateway connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: canvasHostUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the canvas host if available.

methods.name: cachedMainSessionKey
methods.description: Returns the cached main session key from the last snapshot.

methods.name: cachedGatewayVersion
methods.description: Returns the cached gateway server version from the last snapshot.

methods.name: snapshotPaths
methods.description: Returns configuration and state directory paths from the last snapshot, if available.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an AsyncStream to subscribe to gateway push updates.

methods.name: mainSessionKey
methods.description: Obtains or retrieves from cache the main session key from the gateway.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks the health/status of the gateway connection.

methods.name: setHeartbeatsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables heartbeat messages on the connection.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends an agent message to the gateway with invocation parameters.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event with given parameters.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status report of installed skills.

methods.name: skillsInstall
methods.description: Installs a skill identified by name and install ID.

methods.name: skillsUpdate
methods.description: Updates a skill with specified parameters such as enabling, API key, environment variables.

methods.name: sessionsPreview
methods.description: Fetches previews for specified session keys with optional limits.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a given session Key.

methods.name: chatSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments.

methods.name: chatAbort
methods.description: Attempts to abort a chat run by its ID.

methods.name: talkMode
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, optionally specifying a phase.

methods.name: voiceWakeGetTriggers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of triggers for voice wake-up.

methods.name: voiceWakeSetTriggers
methods.description: Sets the triggers for voice wake-up.

methods.name: nodePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a node pairing request.

methods.name: nodePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a node pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a device pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a device pairing request.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the cron scheduler.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: Lists all cron jobs, possibly including disabled ones.

methods.name: cronRuns
methods.description: Retrieves logs of cron job runs.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Forces a cron job to run immediately.

methods.name: cronRemove
methods.description: Removes a cron job.

methods.name: cronUpdate
methods.description: Updates a cron job with a provided patch.

methods.name: cronAdd
methods.description: Adds a new cron job with specified payload.
